import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNext()) {
            String s = scanner.next();
            System.out.print(s.charAt(0));
            int ans = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i < s.length(); i++) {
                if (ans == 0 && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && i + 1 < s.length() && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                    System.out.print("@");
                    ans = 1;
                    i++;
                    continue;
                }
                if (i + 2 < s.length() && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                    System.out.print(".");
                    i += 2;
                    continue;
                }
                System.out.print(s.charAt(i));
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
